_about: Self-expiring allowlist of OFFICIAL conformance-suite tests that are known to fail against a named golden for a diagnosed, filed reason (D4-06 / E1). Semantics per run (official_crosscheck.py): an entry is USED when its test failed this run; STALE (gate FAIL) when the test PASSED while the entry is unexpired — the exception outlived the defect, delete it; EXPIRED (gate FAIL, regardless of outcome) when any `expires_on` condition holds: `samples_pin_not` — the lock's reference_sample_server.commit is no longer that SHA (the golden moved; re-derive), `or_pr_merged` — the named PR is merged (checked by `gh api` GET when online; a stubbed `gh` in --selftest), `or_date` — today is past it. Nothing may be listed without `upstream`. Registered in conformance/coverage/expiry_registers.json (review_by 30 d, moving tier — the truth depends on the samples pin).
